deepa_cs: Async CS standup — renewal cohort B. Quick format: (What I did / Blockers / Today)

deepa_cs: What I did: confirmed 3 at-risk accounts, opened two support tickets for webhook failures; Blockers: webhook retries causing duplicate embeddings (double-insert), need eng help to prevent duplicates; Today: follow up with eng, prepare churn notes for AMs.

josh_eng: Saw duplicate embeddings in logs last night. Quick Q: is the dedupe relying on idempotency keys? I can triage lock behavior. Can you paste a sample id?

deepa_cs: Sample embedding id: emb_4f1b9c. Also customer saw a 504 from /v1/embeddings when batch_size=64 — maybe timeout + retry combo.

mari_support: FYI Ontide (renewal next week) is the impacted customer, NPS dropped. AMs notified. @kevin_pm can you join async please?

kevin_pm: On it. Prioritize webhook lock fix if possible. If not quick, mitigation: route Ontide to lower batch size or a dedicated instance for the renewal window.

alex_sd: Quick code ping — PR #4523 updates lock retry logic and tightens dedupe check. Josh, I put you as reviewer. Tests + changelog included.

josh_eng: Reviewing now. CI flake on test/test_locks.py, rerunning. If flaky, will add stronger assertions.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued for eng-staging at 2024-04-12T09:30:00Z by josh_eng.

josh_eng: Staging deploy succeeded. I ran a targeted run against sample id emb_4f1b9c, no duplicate on staging. Still seeing one duplicate on prod from yesterday's window, will recheck after merge/rollout.

deepa_cs: If PR lands, can we add a short-term CS console toggle: `force_single_insert`? AMs could flip for Ontide while we monitor.

mari_support: We could run a manual remediation script, but that's fragile for each renewal. Toggle is preferred so AMs can act without eng on-call.

kevin_pm: Scope decision: Ontide = P1 (renewal ~$200k), others P2. If PR can't land today, plan B = lower batch to 16 for Ontide + rate-limit to reduce retry surface.

alex_sd: I can add a temporary feature flag in Flags service with low blast radius; easy rollback.

josh_eng: Merge complete. Rolling to prod in ~10m. Will post rollout monitor link once started.

deploy-bot: Rollout to prod started by josh_eng.

deepa_cs: Thanks all — I'll update AMs and publish a short checklist for Ontide (lower batch, monitor embeddings, AM outreach). Any final blockers?

mari_support: Add me to on-call/rotation for Ontide coverage today please.

deepa_cs: Done — added mari_support to on-call. I'll DM the list of affected IDs + next steps. :thumbsup:
